cases.name: Maria Strazzera-Zeta
cases.about: Her Facebook page indicated her DOB was 9/17/1972. On her Go Fund Me, her daughter Lisa Henderson wrote: "As many of you know, she was a loving and caring mother. Always there when someone needed her and supported everyone around her. Maria was also a very outgoing, fun and loud spirited person. My mom always did everything that she could do for those that she loved. Some people also knew her as the fun “white girl Maria”.
